What the Service does

You photograph an item, and the Service uses artificial intelligence and online market research to estimate its likely retail price range and a suggested wholesale (buying) price. Each estimate is called a "valuation."

Estimates, not appraisals

Valuations are estimates generated by AI. They are not professional appraisals, authentications, or guarantees of what an item will sell for, and they can be wrong. Condition, authenticity, markings, and local demand can change an item's value. Decisions to buy, sell, or keep an item are yours alone. Don't use a valuation for insurance, tax, estate, legal, or lending purposes.
